nerves-um.title: “Um” and “uh” are mistakes.
nerves-um.finding: Linguists found that “uh” and “um” work like words: they tell listeners a short delay is coming. In one set of studies, listeners even recognised the next word faster after “uh”.
nerves-um.meaning: A few are normal and even useful. It is a stream of them that distracts.
nerves-um.doThis: Don't fight every one. Swap some for a short silent pause, especially before your main point.
nerves-um.keyLine: A few fillers are normal; swap some for a silent pause.

recall.question: What do “uh” and “um” tell a listener?
